$description: Split button component tokens (D-13) plus the general Menu collections. Menu tokens stay here until the Menu component owns them; the Menu collection name does not change when they move. Every value aliases a semantic token.

$descriptions.gap: Space between segments; they touch. Bind to: split button auto-layout gap.
$descriptions.inner-radius: Corner radius where segments meet. Bind to: inner corners.
$descriptions.outer-radius: Corner radius at the outer ends. Bind to: outer corners.
$descriptions.inner-border-width: Border width where segments meet. Bind to: inner strokes.
$descriptions.divider-width: Divider width. Bind to: Divider stroke weight.
$descriptions.divider: Divider colour, the same for every variant. Bind to: Divider stroke.

$descriptions.container: Menu surface. Bind to: menu frame fill.
$descriptions.radius: Corner radius. Bind to: frame corner radius.
$descriptions.padding: Inner padding. Bind to: frame padding.
$descriptions.offset: Distance from the trigger. Use for: menu position.

$descriptions.height: Row height. Bind to: menu row height.
$descriptions.padding-inline: Start and end padding, mirrored in RTL. Bind to: left and right padding.
$descriptions.gap: Space between items. Bind to: auto-layout gap.
$descriptions.icon-size: Icon size. Bind to: icon width and height.
$descriptions.state-layer/hovered: Translucent overlay on hover (pointer only). Bind to: State layer fill.
$descriptions.state-layer/pressed: Translucent overlay while pressed. Bind to: State layer fill.
$descriptions.label/default: Label colour at rest and when focused. Bind to: label text fill.
$descriptions.label/disabled: Label colour when disabled. Bind to: label text fill in Disabled variants.
$descriptions.icon/default: Icon colour at rest and when focused. Bind to: icon fill.
$descriptions.focus-ring: Inset focus ring colour. Bind to: focus ring stroke.
